Wuhan Human Resources and Social Security Bureau East Lake High-tech Development Zone Branch
Wuhan Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, East Lake High-tech Development Zone Branch

1. Based on Wu Zheng Gui [2015] No. 15, Wu Zheng Gui [2018] No. 31, E Cai She [2017] No. 102, Wu Cai She [2018] No. 413; implement employment management laws and regulations, strictly enforce employment policies, and coordinate the use of employment subsidy funds; promote employment and entrepreneurship initiatives to advance the full employment goals of the High-Tech Zone.

2. Based on the Social Insurance Law, the Work-related Injury Insurance Regulations, and the Notice on Extending Service Hours at Some Public Service Windows in the City by the Wuhan Municipal Government General Office (Wu Zheng Ban [2009] No. 109), undertake social insurance service operations in the East Lake New Technology Development Zone.

3. Based on the Labor Contract Law, the Labor Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Law, and the Labor Inspection Regulations, undertake comprehensive labor administration work, including labor employment and labor inspection enforcement, in the East Lake New Technology Development Zone; investigate and handle wage arrears of migrant workers, safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of vulnerable groups; maintain the rights of both labor and capital, standardize legitimate employment practices by employers, guide workers to protect their rights in accordance with the law, and construct a harmonious and stable labor-capital relationship in the region, which is of great significance.

Clarify the main directions and tasks of the budget funds applied for in the current year:

1. Organize public recruitment activities to broaden channels for serving unemployed individuals and assist disadvantaged individuals in achieving employment; accept subsidy applications for job intermediary services from institutions within the jurisdiction; accept social insurance subsidy applications for flexible workers and enterprises that absorb disadvantaged individuals; accept applications for vocational skills training subsidies for individuals and entrepreneurship training subsidies from designated training schools within the jurisdiction; accept small-guaranteed loan applications from individuals and small and medium-sized enterprises; accept one-time entrepreneurship subsidy applications from residents within the jurisdiction; accept applications for vocational skills assessment subsidies; accept applications for employment incentive subsidies from enterprises that absorb registered poor laborers.

2. Conduct social insurance registration, cancellation, annual inspection, changes, transfer, and other services within the jurisdiction, and be responsible for expanding social insurance coverage; provide business guidance and services to the Donghu Development Zone's industrial parks and administrative service centers; conduct social security card production and distribution, and ensure the normal operation of the insurance information system; provide extended services on Saturdays; optimize the service level at the social security window to improve service environment and quality.

3. Review old-age insurance benefits and unemployment insurance benefits, and conduct preliminary reviews and approvals for early retirement of employees in special positions and early retirement due to illness.

4. Review medical insurance benefits and maternity insurance benefits, conduct initial reviews of work-related injury incidents, on-site inspections of major work-related injury and fatal work-related injury incidents, and supervise designated medical institutions within the jurisdiction.

5. Conduct on-site and written audits of participating enterprises within the jurisdiction; conduct annual inspections of labor employment, special inspections of migrant workers' wage payments and the cleanup and regulation of human resources markets, handle labor security inspection cases, and conduct two-network labor security inspections within the jurisdiction; promptly handle labor disputes within the jurisdiction, accept and handle labor dispute arbitration cases, and complete approvals for special working hours, human resources, and private vocational training schools within the legal time limit.
Budget for the first two years and changes in the current year's budget

1. Budget allocation for the previous two years: The budget amount for 2018 was 36,100,000 yuan, and for 2019 it was 54,400,000 yuan.
2. Changes in the current year's budget and reasons: The budget amount for 2020 is 54,400,000 yuan, an increase of 1,290,000 yuan compared to 2019, mainly due to increased subsidies for the pension fund of government agencies and public institutions, management expenses for employment and social insurance, and expenditures for human resources and social security administration.

Methods for Determining the Cost of Work in Process at the End of the Period
In product valuation, only the cost of raw materials consumed is considered, excluding wages and manufacturing overheads / the remaining costs are included in the cost of completed products.
The proportion of raw materials is very large / The proportion of labor and manufacturing costs is very small.
Allocate production costs based on the ratio of the number of completed products to the equivalent units of ending work in process to determine the costs for both.
The quantity of work-in-progress varies significantly from period to period / a large quantity at the end of the period / the proportions of cost items are roughly equal.
The method for calculating the end-of-period work-in-progress cost based on the quantity of work-in-progress at each process and its cost item quota indicators.
Production is stable / consumption quotas for each process are accurate / the quantity of work-in-progress at the end of the period is stable
A method for allocating and calculating the costs of completed products and end-of-period work-in-progress based on the proportions of quota consumption or quota cost.
Accurate and Stable Consumption Quota / Products with Significant Fluctuations in the Quantity of Work-in-Progress at the End of Each Period
Fixed Number at the Beginning of the Year

1-By the end of November, the work-in-progress inventory is equal to the beginning-of-year figure. The work-in-progress inventory cost is recalculated and determined at the end of the year based on the physical inventory count and production expenses.
Products with small fluctuations in the end-of-period work-in-progress amounts/stable end-of-period work-in-progress quantities
Allocate raw material costs, labor costs, and manufacturing overhead to finished goods based on the ratio of the quantities of work-in-progress to finished goods.

End-of-period work-in-progress is nearly completed/it is just未验收入库的部分在英文中需要更具体的商务或工业术语来表达，但根据上下文，可以翻译为 "尚未正式入库" 或 "未正式完成最终检验"。但是，为了保持翻译的简洁和直接，我将这部分翻译为 "尚未正式入库"。请看完整的翻译：End-of-period work-in-progress is nearly completed and is treated as finished goods since it has not yet been formally warehoused.
Although there are work-in-progress at the end of each period, the costs are not calculated / all production costs incurred during the period are borne by the finished products of the period.
Whether to calculate the end-of-period work-in-progress is insignificant for finished goods due to the small and stable quantity.
